templates.why_chosen: The minimal N=2 case: an Edge PoP hub splits traffic exactly 50/50 into two identical Region spokes, each an identical Zone1/Stateful pair, with a bidirectional replication arrow standing in for the hub-spoke return path.
templates.what_to_learn: When there are genuinely only two spokes, skip the ellipsis and draw both in full, identically; a single yellow box can flag a special-case zone, but this exemplar's weakness is not legending what that highlight colour means.
